{{Quote|The Sulfur Lake Pirates aren't the brightest pirate band on Lok. First, they named themselves after the lake where they have their 'hidden' lair.|[[Choster]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Choster|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout''' was the secret base of the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I established the safeguards on their security system. It's not too dangerous, but does keep visitors out of the back room. Anyone who wants to enter needs to punch in a series of codes, which only the pirates know.|Choster, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwC" />}}
The Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout was a large and deep cave located near the [[Sulfur Lake]], on the planet Lok.<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk |Lok}}</ref> It was the headquarters of the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]], a bloodthirsty group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active on the planet. In fact, the pirates chose their name after the location of the hideout. Hence, they unwittingly revealed to their enemies that their base was located near the Sulfur Lake, and indeed their hidden lair was soon discovered.<ref name="SWG:SwC" />

To counterbalance the discovery of their hideout, the Sulfur Lake Pirates established a sophisticated security system to prevent access to their lair.<ref name="SWG:SwC" /> In addition, the base was guarded by a number of pirates and trained [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD" /> Furthermore, the Bridge Troll, a large [[gurk]] trained by the Sulfur Lake Pirates for combat, patrolled the hideout.<ref name="SWG:KtBT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kill the Bridge Troll|Lok}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I have a feeling the Sulfur Lake Pirates may get their hands on the droid before us. If so, this easy scavenge job will turn into an infiltration of their hideout.|[[Vana Sage]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MVS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet Vana Sage|Lok}}</ref>}}
Upon the discovery of their hidden lair, the Sulfur Lake Pirates hired the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Choster]] to set up the defenses of the bases. However, as they attempted to assassinate him when the job was done, he never revealed to them the weaknesses of the security system.<ref name="SWG:SwC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed-landed near the hideout after it took off from a secret [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial mining installation]] on Lok. Indeed, the Sulfur Lake Pirates quickly salvaged anything valuable from its cargo. The crash was then discovered by [[Nym]]'s [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], the most powerful criminal group on Lok and arch enemies of the Sulfur Lake Pirates. As the Revenants had never been able to infiltrate the Imperial mine, Nym's head of security, [[Vana Sage]], realized that the cargo could contain interesting information regarding Imperial activities on Lok.<ref name="SWG:MVS" /> Sage thus tasked a group of spacers who had recently joined the Lok Revenants with retrieving Imperial data from the cargo.<ref name="SWG:RtDD" />

To this end, the spacers and one of Nym's [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] raided the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout. Thanks to the help of Choster, the engineer who was eager to take his revenge on the Sulfur Lake Pirates, the spacers and the slicer bypassed the pirate security system and infiltrated the base.<ref name="SWG:RtDD" /> During the assault, the spacers killed the [[Bridge Troll]]<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> as well as the [[pharple]] known as [[Nym's Girlfriend]].<ref name="SWG:EB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Embarrassing Breakup|Lok}}</ref> They also placed [[Listening device/Legends|surveillance devices]] all around the base<ref name="SWG:PtSD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Place the Surveillance Devices|Lok}}</ref> and rescued a member of the Lok Revenants who had been captured by the Sulfur Lake Pirates.<ref name="SWG:RtLR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rescue the Lok Revenant|Lok}}</ref> One of the spacers also collected an [[Obsidian Lance|obsidian lance]] in the hideout.<ref name="SWG:RMWMIII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark III}}</ref> Finally, after killing numerous pirates, the spacers collected the [[memory module]] of an Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was present in the crashed ship and brought it back to [[Nym's Base|Nym's palace]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout was added to the game as part of "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> This questline was later revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
